summary.text: Sharon Cooper, a Republican, represents House District 45 in the Georgia House of Representatives, to which she was first elected in 1996.

paragraphs.text: According to her legislative biography, Cooper was born in Houston, Texas, and holds a B.S. in child development, an M.A. in education and an M.S. in nursing.
The biography says she has written two textbooks on psychiatric nursing and that her district is in East Cobb County.
